records.company_overview: Postman is the leading collaboration platform for API-development, used by more than 40 million users and 500,000 companies worldwide. Postman is an elegant, flexible environment used to build connected software via APIs, quickly, easily and accurately.
records.target_audience: Engineers and API developers across individuals, teams, and enterprises.

records.company_overview: Supabase is an open-source Firebase alternative built on Postgres, offering a full suite of backend services including authentication, real-time, storage, and edge functions. It provides developers with a scalable, developer-friendly platform that is fully open-source and community-driven.
records.target_audience: Developers building web and mobile applications, startups, and SaaS companies looking for a scalable, open-source backend.

records.company_overview: Vapi is a unified platform that enables enterprises to build, test, and deploy voice agents quickly, ensuring fast, high-quality support for customers. It offers orchestration, real-time monitoring, and enterprise-grade configurability, allowing companies to scale to millions of calls with sub-500ms latency while maintaining high CSAT scores.
records.target_audience: Enterprises and Fortune 100 companies seeking scalable, secure, and compliant voice agent platforms.
